name: Waddah_Attar_Win
summary: Waddah Attar Win is a trend-following EA based on the Waddah Attar Explosion indicator, which combines MACD histogram analysis with Bollinger Band and moving average convergence to identify explosive trend movements. It enters trades when the indicator detects a strong directional breakout confirmed by expanding momentum and trend alignment, aiming to capture large trend moves from early breakout stages.
summary_zh: Waddah Attar Win是一个基于Waddah Attar Explosion指标的顺势交易EA，该指标结合MACD柱状图分析与布林带和移动平均线收敛来识别爆发性趋势运动。当指标检测到强劲的方向性突破并确认动量扩张和趋势对齐时，EA入场交易，旨在从突破早期阶段捕获大趋势行情。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于Waddah Attar Explosion指标，这是一个将MACD动量分析与布林带波动性分析相结合的复合指标。入场条件为：MACD柱状图从零轴穿越并扩大，同时布林带宽度扩张确认趋势爆发，指标线颜色和方向确认趋势方向。多头入场需要指标显示正值且上升趋势动能增强，空头入场需要指标显示负值且下降趋势动能增强。出场条件通常包括反向信号出现或固定的止盈止损水平。仓位管理方面，EA支持固定手数交易模式，部分版本包含基于账户余额的动态仓位计算。资金管理相对简单，依赖用户自行设置合理的止损距离和手数比例，缺少自动风险比例计算机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the Waddah Attar Explosion indicator, a composite indicator that combines MACD momentum analysis with Bollinger Band volatility analysis. Entry conditions require the MACD histogram to cross the zero line and expand while Bollinger Band width expansion confirms a trend explosion, with indicator line color and direction confirming the trend direction. Long entries need the indicator showing positive values with increasing upward momentum, while short entries need negative values with increasing downward momentum. Exit conditions typically include the appearance of a reversal signal or fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading mode, with some versions including dynamic position calculation based on account balance. Money management is relatively simple, relying on the user to set reasonable stop-loss distances and lot size ratios, lacking automatic risk percentage calculation mechanisms.

parameters.name: Sensitivity
parameters.description: 指标灵敏度参数，控制信号触发阈值
parameters.description_en: Indicator sensitivity parameter, controls signal trigger threshold

parameters.name: DeadZonePip
parameters.description: 死区点数，低于此值不产生信号
parameters.description_en: Dead zone in pips, no signal generated below this value

parameters.name: ExplosionPower
parameters.description: 爆发力度阈值，确认趋势强度
parameters.description_en: Explosion power threshold, confirms trend strength

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Initial stop loss distance, 0 for no initial SL

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit per order in pips

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 追踪止损点数，0表示不启用
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop distance in pips, activates after price moves beyond this

pros: 结合MACD动量和布林带波动性的双重确认，减少虚假信号
趋势爆发识别逻辑清晰，能捕捉早期大趋势行情
死区过滤机制有效过滤市场震荡期的噪音信号
pros_en: Dual confirmation combining MACD momentum and Bollinger Band volatility reduces false signals
Clear trend explosion identification logic captures early major trend moves
Dead zone filtering mechanism effectively filters noise signals during market consolidation
cons: 止损和止盈默认值为0，缺乏强制风控保护，存在较大资金风险
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
在震荡行情中可能产生连续亏损信号，缺乏市场状态自适应切换
cons_en: Stop-loss and take-profit default to 0, lacking mandatory risk control protection, posing significant capital risk
Missing new bar check mechanism, potentially opening repeated positions on the same bar
May generate consecutive losing signals in ranging markets, lacking market state adaptive switching
improvements: 增加强制止损设置和新K线检查机制，防止重复开仓和无限亏损
加入震荡/趋势市场状态识别，在震荡期自动降低仓位或暂停交易
improvements_en: Add mandatory stop-loss setting and new bar check mechanism to prevent repeated entries and unlimited losses
Incorporate ranging/trending market state identification to automatically reduce position size or pause trading during consolidation

risk_points: 止损默认为0，若用户未手动设置则面临无限亏损风险
缺少新K线检查，可能在同一根K线上多次开仓导致过度持仓
risk_points_en: Stop-loss defaults to 0, exposing the user to unlimited loss risk if not manually configured
Missing new bar check may cause multiple position openings on the same bar leading to overexposure
